failed_probe_402.treatment: No returned token usage; excluded from token estimate. No claim about invoice or balance is inferred from HTTP status alone.

release_extrapolation.source: mean measured calibration mix, not actual live release execution

limitations: Public-rate token estimate, not a checked invoice or actual balance change.
Cached input is a subset of total prompt tokens and is subtracted before applying the uncached price.

Reported eval_count is used as the aggregate output metric. Thinking is returned separately as text; no separate reasoning-token usage field exists in these responses. Visible JSON alone is not the billed-token metric and thinking text is not re-tokenized or added again.

Official docs define input/cache/output counters; they do not separately document a thinking billing breakdown for this exact hosted response. The estimate assumes the published output rate applies to reported eval_count.
No future cache-hit rate, output-token count, latency or invoice total is guaranteed.
Both measured calibrations execute sequentially; no cloud-parallel speedup was measured.
Prepaid usage credits are a balance, not a per-run charge.
